dialogues.jp: 「俺で良ければ付き合うよ」
dialogues.en: "With pleasure."
dialogues.text: "With pleasure."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、どれだけ役に立つかって言ったら、アレ
　だけど」
dialogues.en: "Anything I can do to help."
dialogues.text: "Anything I can do to help."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「意見を聞ける相手が居るだけでも、嬉しいで
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad to hear that."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad to hear that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「その代わり、いつもみたいな冗談はなし、で
　すからね」
dialogues.en:
"But really don't choose anything like a joke for her,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"But really don't choose anything like a joke for her,
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Got it."
dialogues.text: "Got it."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり姉思いなのか、生真面目な表情を覗か
せると、しっかりとクギを刺した。
dialogues.en:
Half for her own feelings for her sister, and half because I
don't quite want to experience a Koyomi-sensei-style
crushing.
dialogues.text:
Half for her own feelings for her sister, and half because I
don't quite want to experience a Koyomi-sensei-style
crushing.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「よろしい」
dialogues.en: "Alright!"
dialogues.text: "Alright!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、ことりと朝倉は向こうを探して……
　オレはこっちを探すよ」
dialogues.en:
"Then, if you two are going to look over there... I'd stay
and look around here."
dialogues.text:
"Then, if you two are going to look over there... I'd stay
and look around here."

dialogues.jp:
工藤が片手を上げて、商店街の人混みの中に消
えていく。
dialogues.en:
Kudou waved his hand at us, then disappeared into the crowd
of people.
dialogues.text:
Kudou waved his hand at us, then disappeared into the crowd
of people.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱりなぁ……」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何がやっぱりなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あいつ、見るからに爽やかだろ？　女の人の
　好みとかよく知ってそうだなって思ったんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"He's really popular, isn't he? It's like he knows all the
ways to get women to fall in love with him."
dialogues.text:
"He's really popular, isn't he? It's like he knows all the
ways to get women to fall in love with him."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「爽やかとよく知っているのは関係ないと思う
　んですけど……でもまぁ、そうかも知れませ
　んね」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think being popular has anything to do with that...
and I'm pretty sure he doesn't do that intentionally."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think being popular has anything to do with that...
and I'm pretty sure he doesn't do that intentionally."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「工藤君なら、良く知ってると思います」
dialogues.en: "I don't think he's one to lead people on intentionally."
dialogues.text: "I don't think he's one to lead people on intentionally."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「妙に実感こもってるな。工藤のこと、そんな
　に詳しいなんて、ふたりって仲良かったっ
　け？」
dialogues.en:
"That's pretty weird. How do you know so much about Kudou?
Are you two that close?"
dialogues.text:
"That's pretty weird. How do you know so much about Kudou?
Are you two that close?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うーん……というより、女のカンって奴です
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Not reaaaally... just call it women's intuition."
dialogues.text: "Not reaaaally... just call it women's intuition."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……女のカンねぇ」
dialogues.en: "...Women's intuition, huh."
dialogues.text: "...Women's intuition, huh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、その女のカンで、俺はどうよ？　良
　く知ってそう？」
dialogues.en:
"Then what does that women's intuition think about me? How
popular would I be around girls?"
dialogues.text:
"Then what does that women's intuition think about me? How
popular would I be around girls?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、えーっと……あははは」
dialogues.en: "Ehhh, heh.... heh heh heh..."
dialogues.text: "Ehhh, heh.... heh heh heh..."

dialogues.jp: 微妙に俺から視線を逸らすことり。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked away while giggling.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked away while giggling.

dialogues.jp: 正直な奴め。
dialogues.en: You don't need to be that frank...
dialogues.text: You don't need to be that frank...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それじゃ、私達も行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "A, anyway, let's start looking!"
dialogues.text: "A, anyway, let's start looking!"

dialogues.jp:
エレガントに指を立て、商店街を先に進むこと
りの後を、従者よろしくついていく俺だった。
dialogues.en:
Pointing an elegant finger forward, Kotori headed further
into the shopping district first, with her servant following
behind.
dialogues.text:
Pointing an elegant finger forward, Kotori headed further
into the shopping district first, with her servant following
behind.

dialogues.jp:
それから、色々と見て回ったり、工藤が選んだ
ものを見たりしたのだが……プレゼントは結局
決まらなかった。
dialogues.en:
In the end, despite how much we and Kudou looked around the
place... we still couldn't decide on a present.
dialogues.text:
In the end, despite how much we and Kudou looked around the
place... we still couldn't decide on a present.

dialogues.jp:
ま、それだけ暦先生の事が好きで、慎重だって
事だろうな。
dialogues.en:
Well, she told us that whatever it is isn't that important
yet, so it'd be okay.
dialogues.text:
Well, she told us that whatever it is isn't that important
yet, so it'd be okay.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりに付き合う◆
dialogues.en: ◆With Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆With Kotori◆

dialogues.jp:
役に立つかどうかは知らないが、ともかく付き
合う事にした。
dialogues.en:
I didn't know how helpful I'd be, but I went along with
Kotori anyway.
dialogues.text:
I didn't know how helpful I'd be, but I went along with
Kotori anyway.

dialogues.jp:
──が、夜になっても結局いいのは見つからな
かった。
dialogues.en:
--We all searched deep into the night, but walked away with
nothing.
dialogues.text:
--We all searched deep into the night, but walked away with
nothing.
